digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end with parseable verdicts and structured output validation on real tickets.
All LLM calls from local gates must route exclusively through Bedrock with zero direct-Anthropic calls, verified via REBAR_USAGE_LOG provider tallies.
Prompt caching must engage (nonzero cache_read_tokens observed) on the Bedrock path across all three gate commands to confirm the cache mechanism functions correctly.
Bedrock cachePoint default TTL matches Anthropic cache_control default TTL (both 5 minutes), and no observable behavioral difference results from the provider switch.
Developer opt-in via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE and revert to Anthropic baseline must be executable in a single step without code modification or manual token/config discovery.
